name: @revlens/extras
description: RevLens extras in pure TypeScript: C++/Rust/MSVC demangling, Go symbol recovery, deep PE (resources, version info, manifest, rich header, Authenticode, installers), ELF notes and kernel modules, Mach-O code signatures, firmware containers, GPU code, V8 and Hermes bytecode, model files, Windows forensic formats, an evidence and claims ledger, and RL environments for agents.
